content.comment_body: I'm using a virtual machine on my Apple M1 Mac Mini with Windows 11, and when I try to launch [product_name] software, it starts briefly but then closes immediately. Can anyone help? I'm not sure if the issue is with [product_name] software or the Parallels virtual environment. Windows version is 11.
To clarify, I'm running Windows 11 and the software in question is [product_name].

This thread has been closed because the question was posted twice. A duplicate topic titled 'Apple Mac Mini M1 with Parallels does not run [product_name]' has been published in the [product_name] software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing crashes when trying to run [product_name] software on Windows 11 using Parallels virtual machine on an Apple M1 Mac. They are uncertain if the problem lies with the software or the Parallels environment. No troubleshooting steps are discussed, and the thread is closed due to duplicate posting.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that [product_name] will operate reliably on Windows 11 under Parallels on their Mac M1 Mini.
